title: Ignore expired pressure reports but reapply renewed live peer gates

contract.intent: Ignore expired pressure reports but reapply renewed live peer gates
preconditions: Caller-owned DrainToken and CapacityPeer snapshots exactly listed in initial_state; production drain::fleet_status called directly
No simulated writes to State, no transport, store or actual drain execution; result is native policy output
Pressure samples are synthetic byte-valued facts, not measured RSS, allocator, cgroup or container enforcement
The immutable source/runtime-manifest pins and exact implementation must pass preflight before any authorized future run
